name: Ninja Dreamer
body:
The dream dimension is the source from which dreamers garner their mystical ki powers and arcane mastery of illusion magic.

A dreamer has the following class features.

Class Skills

A dreamer gains Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (planes), and Spellcraft, but does not gain Intimidate, Knowledge (nobility), and Perform.

This alters class skills.

Rejuvenating Sleep (Ex)

A dreamer’s sleep is especially beneficial. At 1st level, a dreamer requires half the amount of sleep that a creature of their kind normally does. Furthermore, beginning in the first encounter after a dreamer has slept, she gains a circumstance bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks equal to half the number of hours she spent sleeping (maximum +4). This bonus lasts for 1 minute per dreamer level or until the encounter is over, whichever comes first.

This replaces poison use.

Illusive Magic

At 1st level, a dreamer gains the ability to cast arcane spells. A dreamer’s spell list contains all the spells of the divination and illusion schools from the sorcerer/wizard’s spell list, excluding all else. A dreamer uses the bard spell tables to determine her base daily spell allotment and her spells known, and like a bard, she can cast any spell she knows without preparing it ahead of time. To learn or cast a spell, a dreamer must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a dreamer’s spell is 10 + the spell level + the dreamer’s Charisma modifier. A dreamer must spend 1 hour daydreaming after getting (the equivalent of) 8 hours of restful sleep to prepare her mind to cast spells for the day.

This replaces sneak attack and all of its iterations.

Illusion Spotter (Ex)

At 3rd level, a dreamer gains a +2 bonus on saving throws made to see through illusions. At 6th level, whenever a dreamer comes within 10 feet of an illusion, she receives an immediate Will save to notice the illusion for what it really is. This check should be made secretly by the GM. At 12th level, once per day, as a free action, a dreamer can function as though under the effects of true seeing for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

This replaces no trace and all of its improvements.

Bed Time (Su)

At 4th level, as a move action, a dreamer can emit a 10-footradius burst centered on herself that causes creatures to become drowsy, moving and reacting sluggishly. Creatures within the burst must succeed on a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the dreamer’s level + her Charisma modifier) or suffer a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, Perception checks, and Reflex and Will saving throws for a number of rounds equal to the dreamer’s Charisma modifier (minimum 1). A successful save reduces the duration to 1 round. At 8th level, this burst extends to 15 feet, and the dreamer can exclude a number of creatures equal to her Charisma modifier from its effects. A dreamer can use this ability once per day, and one additional time at 8th level.

This replaces uncanny dodge and improved uncanny dodge.

Waking Nightmare (Sp)

A dreamer can cloud the minds of her foes with nightmarish visions. At 6th level, as a standard action, a dreamer can select a target within 60 feet of herself to become frightened for a number of rounds equal to 1 + her CH modifier. On a successful Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the dreamer’s level + her Charisma modifier), the target is shaken instead. At 12th level, the target becomes panicked instead of frightened on a failed save. A dreamer can use this ability once per day, and one additional time per day at 12th level.

This replaces light steps.

Just a Dream (Su)

At 20th level, once per day, as an immediate action, when a dreamer would be reduced to zero or fewer hit points from a melee attack, she can expend 1 ki point to momentarily shift her body to the dream dimension, avoiding the attack altogether. The dreamer instantly reappears in an unoccupied square of her choosing within 15 feet of her attacker.

This replaces the portion of hidden master that pertains to sneak attack; hidden master is otherwise not altered.
